ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: On the left side of the image is a stalagmite age—height curve, with the vertical axis as height (mm) and the horizontal axis as age (kaB.P, thousands of years before present); the curve indicates the height reached or growth changes of the stalagmite in different ages. On the right side is a schematic section of a stalagmite, where growth layers from bottom to top can be seen, and the ages corresponding to different layers are marked, such as 31.44, 18.29, 16.96, 15.21, etc. This indicates that the material discusses the environmental information recorded by the growth layers of the stalagmite in different ages. According to the wording of the question stem, stalagmites are formed by deposition from dripping water containing calcium carbonate: on the one hand, they are affected by water evaporation and drip-water recharge, and drip-water recharge is related to precipitation; on the other hand, when cave temperature is relatively high, the amount of CO2 dissolved in the water decreases, and calcium matter is more easily precipitated, indicating that temperature affects calcium carbonate deposition. Therefore the environmental elements that stalagmites can mainly indicate are air temperature and precipitation. The question has already given "and precipitation," so the blank should be air temperature.

method.CoT_raw:
图像中左侧是石笋年龄—高度曲线，纵轴为高度（mm），横轴为年龄（kaB.P，距今千年），曲线表示石笋在不同年代达到的高度或生长变化；右侧是石笋剖面示意，能看到自下而上的生长层，并标注了不同层位对应的年龄，如31.44、18.29、16.96、15.21等。这说明材料讨论的是石笋不同年代生长层所记录的环境信息。
